column4: Continue from the reference image, same locked camera, identical composition, only the doll's head turns toward the tallest mirror at frame right. Preserve every pixel-level anchor: mirror frames, background, body, shoulders, flower, threads, lighting and crop are unchanged. Rotate only head and gaze a small amount toward the tallest mirror, no other changes, clean hard-edged print shapes.

Continue from the reference image, same locked camera, identical composition, only the reflected doll's eyelids close in a single blink. The external doll remains perfectly still with unchanged open eyes. Preserve exact mirror boundary, faces, flower, hair, body pose, composition, lighting and all pixel anchors; only reflection eyelids change. No new marks or objects.

Continue from the reference image, same locked camera, identical composition, only the reflected doll opens her eyes and raises one open palm to touch the mirror from inside. The external doll remains perfectly still with unchanged pose and open eyes. Keep the raised hand fully inside the mirror frame and aligned to a clear contact point. Preserve the exact mirror boundary, faces, flower, hair, lighting and all other pixel anchors; only reflected eyes and one reflected arm/hand change. Five clear fingers.

A medium view in the established cathedral mirror bay, same doll model as the turnaround. Compose a clear two-part reflection: the external doll occupies the left third in back three-quarter view, facing right; one tall narrow mirror fills the right half with her exact reflected face and upper body looking back. Keep her flower on the correct side and make it a narrow pointed-petal orange flower with ivory center, black bow and white ribbon tails. Wind-up key protrudes from the center of her back; seen from behind its bow is edge-on, a thin vertical line. The mirror reflection matches her body pose exactly and is separated by a crisp frame boundary for later mirror-only edits. No text, no extra people.
